title: This robot walks into a house it has never seen before and starts working
title_candidates: This robot walks into a house it has never seen before and starts working
Figure's new robot can enter any home and do complex tasks without training
The robot that needs zero extra training to work in your house
How this humanoid robot reads a brand new home the moment it steps inside
A robot that walks into your home for the first time and gets straight to work
caption:
Figure's Helix 2.5 robot just walked into a house it had never seen before and started working, with zero setup.

The robot runs on a neural network that reads any room in real time. No memorized floor plans, no prior instructions. It walks in cold and gets to work.

Figure's stated goal is a robot in every home. After watching this clip, that timeline feels a lot closer than it did a week ago.
